item.title: Release v1.0.0-preview
item.description:
Qwen Code 1.0 Preview is now available. Some interfaces, configuration options, and behaviors may change during Preview.

Highlights

  • Brings together the agent capabilities of Qoder and Qwen Code for code understanding, implementation, debugging, and testing.
  • Supports Qwen and Qoder accounts, multiple model providers, and custom compatible endpoints.
  • Provides native packages for macOS, Linux, and Windows without requiring a separate Node.js installation.
  • Supports session resumption and non-interactive execution for ongoing development, scripting, and automation.

Download the package for your operating system and architecture from Assets below.
